name: Multi-Plane Point Cloud Voxelization and Weight Aggregation
aliases: Pre-processing for Neural Point Cloud Rendering via Multi-Plane Projection
definition: A pre-processing pipeline that projects a 3D point cloud onto multiple parallel planes (voxels) based on depth, groups points by their projected 2D grid location and depth bin, and computes aggregation weights for rendering. It solves the problem of efficiently organizing sparse point cloud data for multi-plane projection rendering by reducing outliers and grouping points spatially.
